purpose: Cover US-204 (engineer sees the FBS DAG): depth columns from dependsOnFbsIds, click-to-highlight closure, inspector with needs/waits links and Open-in-Specs, deep links on #tab=build&sub=dag&entity=<id>, filters that keep the selection, cycle handling and the no-outbound-postMessage guard. Points at the twelve new DAG unit tests under test/view/build-tab.test.js.
title: Build/DAG sub-tab: layout, closure, inspector, deep links, filters, cycles, no outbound postMessage

testCases.description: buildDagLayout places every connected FBS in a column whose index equals its longest dependency depth from dependsOnFbsIds; rows inside a column are ordered by buildOrder ascending.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/build-tab.test.js::buildDagLayout: columns are dependency-depth tiers from dependsOnFbsIds (AC-204-1)

testCases.description: buildDagLayout carries upstream and downstream closures transitively per node; renderBuildDag outlines upstream in link colour and downstream in warning (checked via data-rcf-dag-role on nodes and edges in the client wiring markers).
testCases.testPointer: test/view/build-tab.test.js::buildDagLayout: closures carry upstream and downstream transitively (AC-204-2 / AC-204-3)

testCases.description: buildDagInspectorPayload emits status, area, buildOrder, acCount, buildable, needs and waits (direct + transitive totals) plus needsMeta/waitsMeta for every node, so the client inspector lists them without recomputing the layout.

page-init.js carries the Build/DAG wiring: click-to-highlight writes #tab=build&sub=dag&entity=<id>, applyBuildHash restores the selection and scrolls the node into view (auto-pressing Show-unconnected when the restored node sits in the unconnected lane).
testCases.testPointer: test/view/build-tab.test.js::page-init.js carries the Build/DAG wiring (click-to-highlight, hash round-trip, filters)

testCases.description: DAG filter chips (status, area, Buildable-now, Critical-path, Show-unconnected) in the DagToolbar; applyDagFilters keeps the current selection intact across toggles; renderBuildDag emits the toolbar with the six filter controls and the unconnected count.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/build-tab.test.js::renderBuildDag: toolbar renders status chips, area select, three toggles and the unconnected count

testCases.description: buildDagLayout surfaces cycle members as cycleIds and excludes them from the depth layout; non-cycle FBS still render.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/build-tab.test.js::buildDagLayout: cycles are surfaced as cycleIds and excluded from depth layout (AC-204-6)

testCases.description: The rendered Build tab slice (DAG panel) does not contain any postMessage( call site; the inspector payload rides on a data-rcf-dag-inspector-data attribute, not a function call.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/build-tab.test.js::Build/DAG renderer never emits window.postMessage (AC-204-7, no outbound postMessage)
